title: Foreskin and Circumcision
summary: The foreskin is the retractable skin covering the head of the penis. Circumcision is the removal of the foreskin, usually for religious, cultural or medical reasons.
key_points: Uncircumcised penises need the foreskin gently pulled back and rinsed during washing.
Phimosis is a tight foreskin that won't retract; it may need medical care if it causes pain.
